Photo 1 shows the same console with a second, smaller black box (likely a game case) next to it.

risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen.

risks.proof: A photo of the 'System Storage' screen showing the capacity.

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift or button failure.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate menus or play a game.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the Microsoft Store or have a software update error.
risks.proof: A photo of the 'System Information' screen showing the software version.

Photo of the 'System Storage' screen showing the hard drive capacity.
Photo of the 'System Information' screen showing the software version.
Photo of the back of the console showing the model number and the region label.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
